title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 9 in E major

character.text: Stile antico ricercar-type fugue, alla breve, modelled on Fischer

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to B major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B major, rhythm varied (Alto); Subject in E major (Tenor); Subject in B major (Bass); Subject in E major (Soprano)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times). Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1.
sections.leads: Between two statements in E major; perfect cadence in C♯ minor at bar 16

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in E major (Alto); Subject in B major (Soprano); Subject in C♯ minor, rhythm varied (Bass)

sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B major (Bass); Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to C♯ minor; perfect cadence in F♯ minor at bar 23

sections.leads: From E major to B major; perfect cadence in G♯ minor at bar 35
